desc:
Dino Hide & Seek is a combination of hide and seek and dinosaurs!

🦖 AS DINOSAUR (HIDER): Morph into dinosaurs and hide around the map from the Dino Hunter and survive. DON'T GET CAUGHT!
👀 AS HUNTER (SEEKER): Try to find the dinosaurs hiding and catch them before time runs out. FIND ALL DINOSAURS!

✨ Unlock rarer dinosaurs, discover mutations, and earn rewards as you play!
💰 Collect money to get better dinosaurs and evolutions!
